_: What this repository's gate reads and builds. No census of the files its suite opens has been taken here, so `reads` claims every tracked file (`**`): nothing is gate-inert, the same conservative reading the repository had with no record. `builds` names what the gate (verify.ps1: the solution build and suite; the suite's PooledLawTests Fable-compiles tests/Fuaran.Core.Compute.Tests/Node/PooledLawNode.fsproj, and its LinearAlgebraTests Fable-compiles tests/Fuaran.Core.Compute.Tests/LinearAlgebraNode/LinearAlgebraNode.fsproj, and runs each under node) builds, and `notBuilt` each project file it deliberately does not, with the reason. Checked: the coverage check classifies every tracked project file against the pair, and once `builds` is declared an unreached project is an error and refuses a landing.

notBuilt.reason: archived benchmark-result programs, each kept beside the report it produced as the record of how a reading was taken; run by hand, never built by the gate
